tools.name: check_state
tools.description: Checks whether Sunflower Clinic serves the requested US state and lists the states it serves. The only input is a two-letter USPS state code.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns what treatment costs: the one-time $20 online assessment and, if a provider prescribes, each plan's price. Naltrexone has a quarterly and an annual plan; varenicline has a quarterly plan.

tools.name: get_medication_info
tools.description: Finds Sunflower Clinic’s published medication information. For naltrexone it returns FAQs about uses, evidence, side effects, safety warnings and billing. For varenicline it returns a link to the clinic’s information page.

tools.name: get_start_link
tools.description: Finds the clinic’s assessment link when someone asks where to start. The patient completes the assessment on the clinic website. For an unserved state, the result lists the states served and omits the link. Pass the plan the patient chose, or leave it out if they chose none; annual is naltrexone onl

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_start_link" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
